home.introduction:
I am a student at WCSS with a passion for Aerospace Engineering and STEM. 
I'm a cadet with the 706 Snowy Owl Squadron and have completed a rocketry course through cadets. 
I serve as Co-President of the STEM Club, am a student athlete in badminton, a chess team member, and the lead guitarist of @fishhook_.theband. 
I enjoy balancing science, leadership, sports, and music.

about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm a developer with a background in aerospace engineering. My journey began with curiosity about flight and technology, leading me to combine both passions in innovative projects. I enjoy collaborating, learning, and solving real-world problems through code.

items.title: Composition Assistant Agent
items.description: Built an AI agent that can modify a wave file using prompts from the user
items.detailedDescription: Created an AI agent that utilizes OpenAI's Whisper API for transcribing audio files and the MusicGen model from Hugging Face to generate music based on user prompts. The agent processes an input wave file, transcribes its content, and then generates a modified version of the audio according to the user's specifications. This project showcases the integration of advanced AI models for audio processing and generation.

items.title: Gmail Autoresponder Agent
items.description: Ability to find and reply to emails with LLM auto-generated responses with casual, normal and proffesional tones
items.detailedDescription: Developed an AI-powered Gmail autoresponder agent that automatically scans incoming emails and generates contextually appropriate replies using large language models (LLMs). The agent can tailor responses in various tones, including casual, normal, and professional, enhancing communication efficiency. This project demonstrates the application of AI in automating email management and improving user interaction.

items.title: Chess Game, In Java
items.description: Built a fully functional chess game with engine and LAN play capabilities; with self-made music
items.detailedDescription: Developed a comprehensive chess game in Java, featuring a robust game engine capable of handling all standard chess rules and mechanics. The game supports LAN play, allowing users to compete against each other over a local network. Additionally, I composed original music for the game, enhancing the overall user experience. This project highlights my skills in Java programming, game development, and music composition.
